Hello Hoshizaki team,

Twins Kitchen is building a commercial kitchen equipment marketplace/catalogue and we are interested in accurately representing the relevant products in your range. We are not claiming to be an authorized distributor; we are contacting you to request authorized product media for the products listed below.

Could you please provide a bulk media pack for the matching products/models, rather than individual web images? For each asset, please include the model/product identifier and, where available, the current catalogue or product-sheet reference.

Requested products:
- 79 — 45kg Commercial Ice Maker
- 352 — Automatic Ice Storage Bin
- 400 — High-Capacity Water Dispenser

If you can provide the media, please also confirm in writing that Twins Kitchen may use the supplied product photographs/media on its commercial website/catalogue. If attribution or a specific credit line is required, please tell us and we will follow it. We would also appreciate confirmation of the source URL/product page or catalogue reference for each supplied asset.

Preferred package: ZIP/folder containing original JPG/PNG/WebP product photos plus a CSV/XLSX/PDF model index or filename-to-model mapping. A PDF catalogue or individual images are also acceptable if that is the format you normally provide.

Thank you,
Twins Kitchen

packageHandling.zip: Do not apply directly. Preserve original ZIP, extract to an isolated intake directory, retain manifest/index files and provenance, then run the existing local asset-intake dry-run after rights and identity are confirmed.
packageHandling.pdf: Do not treat PDF pages as automatically reusable images. Preserve the original PDF and use it as a model/specification/provenance reference; request original image files or explicit permission if images need to be extracted.
packageHandling.individualImages: Preserve original filenames and source context. Record source URL, supplier/manufacturer, rights confirmation and model mapping before placing them in the local asset-intake directory.

pipelineEntry: Once authorized assets are received: preserve source package -> record provenance/rights -> reconcile product/model IDs -> place copies in a local supplier-assets intake area -> run existing asset-intake manifest/dry-run -> review VERIFIED/REVIEW/REJECTED/UNRESOLVED -> only explicitly authorized VERIFIED assets may proceed to the existing apply workflow.
